    AI Overview
    Miami University (often referred to as Miami of Ohio) is located in Oxford, Ohio, a town in the Miami Valley region of southwest Ohio. It is approximately 35 miles north of Cincinnati and close to the Indiana border. The school operates regional campuses in Hamilton, Middletown, and West Chester, Ohio. 
    Key Location Details: 
    • Main Campus Address: Oxford, OH 45056.
    • Regional Campuses: Located in Hamilton and Middletown, with a learning center in West Chester.
    • Setting: A traditional,2,138-acre "college town" campus in Butler County. 
    Do not confuse it with Miami, Florida, as the university is in Ohio, named after the Miami Valley and the Myaamia people.

    Description

    Miami University is a public research university in Oxford, Ohio, United States. Founded in 1809, it is the second-oldest university in Ohio and the tenth-oldest public university in the United States. It is named for its location in the Miami Valley, in turn named after the Myaamia people. Wikipedia
    Address: 501 E High St, Oxford, OH 45056
    Acceptance rate: 75.4% (2024) IPEDS
    Undergraduate tuition and fees: In-state tuition 17,809 USD, Out-of-state tuition 40,025 USD (2023 – 24) IPEDS
    Mascot: Swoop the RedHawk
    Current basketball coaches: Travis Steele, Glenn Box
